items.source: Top-level package for the spring-webflux module that contains DispatcherHandler, the main entry point for WebFlux server endpoint processing including key contracts used to map requests to handlers, invoke them, and process the result.
items.translation: `spring-webflux` 模块的顶层包，包含 `DispatcherHandler`，这是 WebFlux 服务器端点处理的主要入口点，包括用于将请求映射到处理器、调用它们并处理结果的关键契约。

items.source: Annotations to declare an RSocket service contract with request methods along with a proxy factory backed by an RSocketRequester.
items.translation: 用于声明带有请求方法的 RSocket 服务契约的注解，以及由 RSocketRequester 支持的代理工厂。

items.source: Support for creating a client proxy for an HTTP service annotated with HttpExchange methods.
items.translation: 支持为带有 HttpExchange 方法的 HTTP 服务创建客户端代理。

items.source: Support for various programming model styles including the invocation of different types of handlers like an annotated controller or a simple WebHandler.
items.translation: 支持各种编程模型风格，包括调用不同类型的处理器，如带注解的控制器或简单的 WebHandler。

items.source: MVC infrastructure for annotation-based handler method processing, building on the org.springframework.web.method.annotation package.
items.translation: 基于 org.springframework.web.method.annotation 包构建的用于注解式处理器方法处理的 MVC 基础设施。

and other core helpers that are not specific to any part of the framework.
